buyer_question: What can we share before scoping?
safe_first_review_input: Redacted workflow names and owner-approved non-sensitive summaries
excluded_material: PHI/ePHI patient records payer files credentials EHR/PMS exports cloud-console access private audit reports
owner_or_adviser_route: Clinic operations owner plus privacy/security adviser if uncertain
external_claim_boundary: No HIPAA compliance proof no patient data no customer claim

buyer_question: Which auth steps need automation or owner escalation?
safe_first_review_input: Non-sensitive step list payer category labels and current owner roles
excluded_material: Actual payer portal screenshots patient IDs authorization numbers clinical documentation

owner_or_adviser_route: RCM/prior-auth owner plus payer/billing adviser as needed

buyer_question: Can AI answer calls or messages safely?
safe_first_review_input: Administrative intent categories escalation examples and approved contact options
excluded_material: Call recordings PHI medical advice triage protocols without adviser approval
deliverable: AI receptionist boundary brief with human handoff and stop rules
owner_or_adviser_route: Clinic owner clinical lead legal/privacy/security adviser review
external_claim_boundary: No AI accuracy no clinical safety no HIPAA attestation claim

buyer_question: Who owns HIPAA BAA AI-use and security answers?
safe_first_review_input: Public vendor question list existing policy names owner roles and evidence-location notes
excluded_material: Private SOC 2/HITRUST reports BAAs contracts access logs screenshots with sensitive details
deliverable: Answer-source map separating answerable proof-needed owner-needed adviser-needed blocked claims
owner_or_adviser_route: Security/privacy owner legal adviser and executive owner
external_claim_boundary: No SOC 2/HITRUST/certification no compliance proof no procurement approval
